description: TP-Link's Omada line of business-grade networking gear for homes and small businesses — Wi-Fi access points, switches, gateways/routers and hardware controllers managed through the Omada cloud platform — sold through the official Omada Store.

evidence.summary: Omada's own store affiliate page states a flat 12% commission on all qualified sales with a 30-day cookie window, applications via Impact (Apply buttons route to app.impact.com), a dedicated affiliate manager, and marketing assets; it explicitly courts YouTube tech reviewers, tech bloggers, and prosumer/smart-home influencers. No earnings-cap statement appears on the page, so the cap is recorded as unknown.
The affiliate page publishes affiliate@omadanetworks.com for program questions.
TP-Link's corporate information page lists TP-Link Systems Inc., 10 Mauchly, Irvine, CA 92618, United States as the corporate headquarters; Omada is TP-Link's networking brand and product line.

name: Omada by TP-Link

reasons.compensation: A flat 12% on all qualified sales with a 30-day cookie, stated on the brand's own page — well above typical consumer-tech rates; no cap statement found, so no uncapped credit.
reasons.contact_access: A published affiliate-program email (affiliate@omadanetworks.com) plus a clear Impact application route on the brand's own page.
reasons.credibility: Omada is the business networking line of TP-Link Systems Inc. (Irvine, CA), one of the world's largest networking brands.
reasons.niche_fit: Networking hardware (Wi-Fi access points, switches, gateways) is core review content for tech, home-lab and smart-home creators, though it skews prosumer rather than mass consumer.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application via Impact; the brand reviews applications for audience fit, so it is not instant-approval.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's own affiliate page names the creator types it wants — YouTube tech reviewers, tech bloggers, smart-home influencers — and supplies banners, logos and product links.

description: Seattle-area maker of rechargeable Bluetooth item trackers (Clip, Card and luggage tags) that work with both Apple Find My and Google's Find Hub networks, with no subscription required; founded in 2013 and still led by its Boeing-engineer founder.

evidence.summary: Pebblebee's February 2025 Business Wire launch release for its Creator (Creative) Collective: Rising Star tier pays 18% commission for the first 1,000 influencers, then 14% ongoing, plus a free Clip or Card, early product access, an exclusive influencer Slack channel and a 15% follower discount code; Elite Creator tier (auto-upgrade after 50 orders or $10,000 revenue) pays 22.5% for the first 50 qualifiers, then 20%. Over 200 payout methods (PayPal, Venmo, gift cards, charity). Sign-up is via the Creator Collective page on pebblebee.com. The recorded rate is the ongoing 14% Rising Star rate. No earnings-cap statement is made, so the cap is unknown; the tier slot limits are rate cohorts, not a stated current creator count, so saturation is unknown.

Pebblebee's homepage states it designed one of the first personal Bluetooth trackers in 2013, is located just outside Seattle, has sold millions of units with 30+ patents filed, and its Universal line is a CNN Underscored Top Pick; trackers work with Apple Find My and Google's Find Hub and recharge about once a year.

name: Pebblebee

reasons.compensation: 14% ongoing Rising Star commission (18% launch cohort), rising to 20-22.5% at Elite, plus free product — top-tier consumer-tech pay; rates come from the Feb 2025 launch release, so current slot status is unverified.
reasons.contact_access: No public partnerships email found on the fetched pages; the only route is the sign-up form on the brand's site.
reasons.credibility: Operating since 2013 with millions of units sold, 30+ patents and national press coverage (CNN Underscored, ZDNet, The Verge).
reasons.niche_fit: Item trackers are natural tech, travel and everyday-carry content, and the program is designed for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube creators.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open sign-up form on pebblebee.com, but the highest-rate cohorts are slot-limited (first 1,000 / first 50) and may be filled.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A creator-first program with its own tiers, free product, early access, a private influencer Slack channel and follower discount codes — strong structured UGC evidence from the brand's own launch release.

description: San Diego-based subscription brand making fresh, air-dried, single-ingredient dog treats and chews in small batches in its own kitchen, customized to each dog's size and dietary needs, with a feed-real-food wellness positioning.

evidence.summary: Real Dog Box's own affiliate page: earn up to 30% on the first box or 10% on the next six boxes, free to join, affiliates get a complimentary Wellness Membership ($22/month value), milestone rewards, a unique short referral link and a real-time dashboard; affiliates must maintain at least three sign-ups per 28-day period to stay active, and paid-search promotion is excluded. The recorded rate is the 30% first-box rate. No earnings-cap statement appears, so the cap is unknown.

The same page states the brand is based in San Diego, California, crafts its treats in small batches in its San Diego kitchen, and features an affiliate success story (a promoter reporting over $5,200 earned).

name: Real Dog Box

reasons.compensation: Up to 30% on the first box and 10% on the next six boxes per the brand's own page, plus a free $22/month Wellness Membership — among the strongest pet rates found; no cap statement, so no uncapped credit.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through the brand's own affiliate page; no public partnerships email was published on the fetched page.
reasons.credibility: Established San Diego DTC brand with its own kitchen and a published affiliate track record, though smaller than national pet brands.
reasons.niche_fit: Fresh single-ingredient dog treats are highly demonstrable pet-niche content (unboxings, feeding routines, treat reviews).
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free, open application on the brand's site; staying active requires three sign-ups per 28 days, a modest activity bar.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program page targets website owners, content creators, health influencers and bloggers, and publishes an affiliate success story and milestone rewards.

description: Ogden, Utah hydration brand founded by brothers Hayden and Jake Wadsworth, known for its 73oz half-gallon water jugs and an expanded line of tumblers, travelers, sleeves and carriers, sold DTC and through retailers including Target, Scheels and Dick's Sporting Goods.

evidence.summary: HydroJug's own Ambassadors & Affiliates page routes creators to TikTok Shop's affiliate program: join via TikTok creator tools, request HydroJug products in the affiliate marketplace, tag products in videos/LIVEs/showcases and earn commission on every sale, with tracking and payouts handled by TikTok. Commission is set per product inside TikTok Shop and varies, so no single rate can be recorded (commission_rate null). The brand states there is no follower minimum from its side. No earnings-cap statement appears, so the cap is unknown.

ZoomInfo lists HydroJug LLC headquarters in Ogden, Utah, describing it as a hydration and drinkware company founded by brothers Hayden and Jake Wadsworth, selling reusable half-gallon jugs, tumblers, travelers, lids, straws and sleeves DTC and through retail stores.

name: HydroJug

reasons.compensation: Commission is real but set per product inside TikTok Shop and not published on the brand's page, so the level cannot be verified from a fetched source — mid-low score despite the program being genuine.
reasons.contact_access: The brand page explains the full join path, but contact is mediated entirely through TikTok Shop; no brand email is published.
reasons.credibility: Fast-growing national brand (Inc. 5000-listed growth) with headquarters in Ogden, Utah and placement in major US retailers.
reasons.niche_fit: Half-gallon jugs and tumblers are staple hydration, gym and day-in-the-life content across TikTok and Instagram.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to all TikTok creators with no follower minimum from the brand's side — only TikTok Shop's own regional eligibility applies.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's own page is a creator playbook — it names the content formats that perform (reviews, GRWM, gym content, vlogs, unboxings) and runs its affiliate route natively inside TikTok.

description: Pet supplement brand (now under Compana Pet Brands) selling science-backed nutritional supplements, shampoos and treats for dogs and cats for over 25 years, claiming more than 1,000,000 pets helped and 10,000 five-star reviews.

evidence.summary: Dinovite's own affiliate page invites creators to apply (Apply buttons route to compana.everflowclient.io, the Everflow platform of parent Compana Pet Brands) and states '30% commission on every successful sale', with resources and brand guidelines for affiliates. No earnings-cap statement appears, so the cap is unknown.

RATE CONFLICT: Lasso's directory lists the Dinovite program at 10% per sale with a 7-day cookie, joining via ShareASale — conflicting with the 30% stated on the brand's own current affiliate page (which routes applications to Everflow). Because sources conflict, commission_rate is recorded as null; the brand page suggests the program may have moved networks, but the current payable rate needs confirmation.

CB Insights lists Dinovite as a family-founded online pet brand headquartered at 101 Miller Drive, Crittenden, Kentucky, United States, acquired by Manna Pro Products in 2021 (the brand now sits under Compana Pet Brands).

name: Dinovite

reasons.compensation: Headline pay could be strong (30% on the brand's own page) but a directory lists 10% via a different network, so the rate is unverified and recorded as null — score held down until confirmed.
reasons.contact_access: Open application on the brand's own page via Everflow; no public partnerships email found.
reasons.credibility: 25+ years in market and over a million pets helped per the brand, now backed by Compana Pet Brands; the conflicting rate listings keep this below top marks.
reasons.niche_fit: Dog and cat supplements for skin, coat and digestion are a core pet-creator niche with clear before/after content angles.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Publicly open application welcoming beginners as well as seasoned affiliates.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's own page is written for bloggers, social media influencers, YouTube creators and small businesses, with resources and brand guidelines supplied.

description: Pet supplement brand founded in 1994 by Garmon Corp. (now owned by Swedencare) and made in Temecula, California, covering some twenty categories — joint, calming, digestive, skin and coat — sold through more than 15,000 US pet shops and online platforms.

evidence.summary: Lasso's affiliate directory lists the NaturVet program at up to 11.25% commission with a 14-day cookie, a $10 payout threshold, no approval requirements, and the network listed as Lasso (product links route to app.getlasso.co; the 11.25% figure has the look of a marketplace-derived rate, so it is single-source and recorded as publicly reported). 'Up to 11.25%' is a rate ceiling, not an earnings cap — no no-cap statement exists, so the cap is unknown.

Swedencare's acquisition release describes NaturVet (Garmon Corp.), founded in 1994, as a premium US pet healthcare company with in-house development and production in Temecula, California, products in about twenty categories sold to over 15,000 US pet shops and online platforms.

name: NaturVet

reasons.compensation: Up to 11.25% per the directory with a low $10 payout threshold; the short 14-day cookie and single-source rate keep this mid-range.
reasons.contact_access: No public affiliate contact or brand application page found; joining runs through Lasso only.
reasons.credibility: In business since 1994, manufactured in its own California facilities, sold in 15,000+ US pet shops and owned by listed pet-health group Swedencare.
reasons.niche_fit: Mainstream pet supplements (calming, joint, digestive) map directly onto pet-owner content and problem/solution videos.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Directory lists no approval requirements — effectively open enrollment through Lasso.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program is listed for pet bloggers and creators in Lasso's directory, but no brand-run creator program or UGC campaign evidence was found on the brand's own pages.

description: Bio Bidet by Bemis sells bidet toilet seats, attachments and smart toilets (Bliss BB-2000, BB-900, Discovery DLS) with heated seats, warm-water wash and air drying, positioned as a DIY-install bathroom upgrade; its BB-2000 was voted Forbes' Best Bidet Overall for 2025 and 2026.

evidence.summary: Lasso's affiliate directory lists the Bio Bidet program at 5% per sale with a 30-day cookie in the Home Improvement category, and its join buttons route to app.impact.com, identifying Impact as the network. No earnings-cap statement appears, so the cap is unknown.

Bio Bidet's homepage sells bidet seats and smart toilets from $189 to $699 with DIY installation in about 20 minutes, advertises free shipping on orders of $199+ in the contiguous US, and carries the 'Forbes Voted Best Bidet Overall 2025 & 2026' badge.

name: Bio Bidet

reasons.compensation: 5% per sale is modest, but on $189-$699 seats it yields meaningful per-order payouts, with a standard 30-day cookie.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through Impact via the directory join route; the brand publishes phone and a contact form but no affiliate email.
reasons.credibility: The bidet line of Bemis, a long-established US bathroom brand, with Forbes Best Bidet Overall honors for 2025 and 2026.
reasons.niche_fit: Bidets are a proven home-upgrade content niche (install videos, bathroom makeovers, hygiene routines) with high product prices.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application on Impact, subject to the network's standard approval.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program is marketed to bloggers and home-improvement creators in the directory listing, but no brand-run creator program evidence was found on the brand's own pages.

description: Toronto-based home accessories design company founded in 1979, known for original, affordable modern housewares — from the Garbino trash can to storage, frames, mirrors and furniture — designed in-house and distributed in more than 120 countries.

evidence.summary: Lasso's affiliate directory lists the Umbra program at 5% per sale with a 30-day cookie in the Home Decor / Home Improvement categories, with join buttons routing to umbra.com (brand-direct application). No earnings-cap statement appears, so the cap is unknown.

Wikipedia describes Umbra as a home accessories design and manufacturing company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, Canada, with satellite offices in the Netherlands, Brazil, the United States and China.

name: Umbra

reasons.compensation: 5% per sale across all products with a 30-day cookie — standard home-decor economics on affordable price points.
reasons.contact_access: No public affiliate email or dedicated program page found; the join route is via the brand's site from the directory listing.
reasons.credibility: Global design brand founded in 1979, headquartered in Toronto and distributed in over 120 countries.
reasons.niche_fit: Design-led everyday housewares are highly visual home-decor content — organization, small-space and room-refresh videos.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application per the directory, with approval typically taking a few days.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The directory positions the program for bloggers, content creators and home enthusiasts; no brand-run creator program was verified on the brand's own pages.

description: IoT hardware maker (RAKwireless Technology Limited) selling LoRaWAN gateways, modules, sensors and Meshtastic/Helium-ready devices through its own online store, aimed at developers, makers and connected-device enthusiasts.

evidence.summary: RAKwireless' own Affiliate Program Terms (last updated May 20, 2025): affiliates sign up through the GoAffPro platform and earn 5% commission on the total sale (excluding shipping, duties and taxes) for purchases in the RAKwireless Store; links carry a 180-day assigned duration, commissions face a 30-day review period, payout is via PayPal on the 1st and 15th of each month with a $20 minimum, self-purchases and PPC bidding are prohibited. No earnings-cap statement appears, so the cap is unknown.

name: RAKwireless

reasons.compensation: 5% is modest, but the 180-day link duration is unusually generous and payout terms (PayPal twice monthly, $20 minimum) are fully published in the brand's own terms.
reasons.contact_access: Only a general web form is referenced in the terms; no affiliate email or named contact is published.
reasons.credibility: Established IoT hardware brand with its own store and formally published program terms governed by Hong Kong law.
reasons.niche_fit: LoRaWAN and IoT hardware serves a focused maker/developer creator niche rather than broad consumer audiences.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open sign-up through GoAffPro for anyone 18+ with a PayPal account, per the published terms.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The terms explicitly allow sharing affiliate links on any social media platform, but there is no creator-specific program, assets or community evidence.

description: Denver-founded smart irrigation company making Wi-Fi sprinkler controllers, smart hose timers and landscape lighting controllers with weather-intelligence scheduling through the Rachio app; founded in 2012 and acquired by Rain Bird in October 2025.

evidence.summary: Lasso's affiliate directory lists the Rachio program at 4% per sale with a 10-day cookie, and its join buttons route to flexoffers.com, identifying FlexOffers as the network. No earnings-cap statement appears, so the cap is unknown.

CB Insights profiles Rachio as a smart-home technology company focused on outdoor water efficiency, founded in 2012 and based in Denver, Colorado, and notes it was acquired by Rain Bird in October 2025.

Rachio's homepage sells the Rachio 3 Smart Sprinkler Controller (from $199.99), Smart Lighting Controller (from $299.99) and Smart Hose Timer, and cites a 4.9-star app with over 150,000 App Store reviews.

name: Rachio

reasons.compensation: 4% per sale with a short 10-day cookie — the weakest pay package in this batch, partly offset by $200-$300 product prices.
reasons.contact_access: No public affiliate contact found; joining runs through FlexOffers only.
reasons.credibility: Category-defining smart irrigation brand founded in 2012, now owned by irrigation major Rain Bird.
reasons.niche_fit: Smart irrigation is solid smart-home and lawn/garden content, though seasonal and narrower than indoor tech.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through FlexOffers, subject to network approval.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program is listed for gardening and home bloggers in the directory; no brand-run creator program evidence was found on the brand's own pages.
